text:
deploybot: Automatic pause: rollout v2.14.0 slot 17 quarantined due to repeated 502/503s in eu-control-plane. Trigger: health-check failures > 3. Quarantine engaged at 09:16 UTC.
sre-ops: copying. seeing auth token timeout spikes from token-svc. correlates with regioning change earlier. digging in.
maya: can someone pin the release so we don't partially roll out? we should avoid half-complete deployments.
deploy-admin: pinning now: `deployctl pin --service inference-api --version v2.14.0 --slot 17 --reason "INC-8433 control-plane errors"`
deploybot: Pin recorded. Rollout frozen for slot 17; subsequent slots paused. Canary traffic drained.
tom: ops, if this is unrelated to our code then let's hold and reschedule. if it's caused by our change, we need rollback plan. what's your read?
sre-ops: initial read shows external token service latency. not seeing application errors or new exception traces in inference-api. ETA for confirmation 25m.
release-manager: do NOT roll back automatically. plan A: pin + reschedule remaining slots to maintenance window 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC. plan B: if ops ties to app change, rollback slot 17 and re-run canary after fix.
maya: i'll prepare rollback commands and a hotfix branch now. creating `hotfix/token-backoff-2026-03-21`.
release-manager: update status page and internal release notes now: short blurb + INC-8433 link. include customer impact: possible delay to scheduled changes.
incident-bot: INC-8433: control-plane degraded in EU; mitigation steps in progress; next update in 10m.
deploy-admin: added tag `hold/INC-8433` and annotated deploy ticket. also added auditors for the reschedule.
maya: rollback (dry-run) command for SRE:
```
# rollback to last stable v2.13.8
deployctl rollback --service inference-api --from v2.14.0 --to v2.13.8 --reason "INC-8433"
```
sre-ops: can run if we confirm app-level regressions. otherwise recommend reschedule + small targeted canary pre-window (30m before main window) to validate.
deploybot: Noted. Next retry for slot 18 moved to 2026-03-22T02:30:00Z (10% targeted canary). slot 17 remains quarantined.
tom: add followup checklist in release doc: pin action, rollback ready command, hotfix branch created, status page updated, reschedule timestamp. assign owners.
release-manager: checklist created and assigned to @maya and @deploy-admin. customer-facing note drafted and queued for approval.
sre-ops: mitigation confirmed: token-svc patched and latencies returning to baseline. recommendation: keep pin, run targeted canary at 02:30 UTC as planned, do not auto-unquarantine slot 17 until canary passes.
maya: acknowledged. i'll run pre-canary smoke tests and report metrics.
release-manager: agreed. we will merge final release note after canary success. closing loop here but will reconvene if metrics deviate. :white_check_mark:
